tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for places, parks, sights, museums, beaches or things to visit in a city, region or near a point. Finds interesting places (sights, museums, parks, nature, beaches and more), ordered by popularity. Returns name, category, city, country, coordinates, distance, a link to the place page (url), a popularity score, a stored travel description and one verified photo with its credit (image, or null). For more about one place, call get_place with the last part of its url. Give q (a place, city or country name, optionally with a category, e.g. "valencia" or "zoo valencia"), or lat/lng of the area the user asks about, or both (q narrowed to radius_km around lat/lng). Optional filters: categories, needs, tastes, parking, setting; tags only rank matching places higher. Write each place name as a markdown link [name](url) when url is present, and show each place's url as the source link. When image is present, show image.url as a markdown image with the author credit. visit_minutes is the typical time visitors spend there, not the time to see everything. attributes gives the five needs as true (known yes) or null (unknown, never a no), and matched_needs lists which of the requested needs the place has. setting (indoor, outdoor, both or null) and parking ({free, paid}, each true or null) follow the same rule. matched_tastes and matched_tags list which of the requested tastes and tags the place hit. content_status is no_description when no travel description is stored; fallback_reason is translation_unavailable when lang differs from the requested one. With q, search_area shows the area q was read as. filter_semantics says how the filters combine.

q.description: Free text: a city, country or place name, optionally with a category ("zoo valencia"). Required unless lat/lng are given.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, decimal degrees. Required (with lng) unless q is given.

lng.description: Longitude of the search center, decimal degrees. Required (with lat) unless q is given.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around lat/lng. Out-of-range values are clamped. Ignored without lat/lng.

categories.description: Only these categories. Empty means all.

needs.description: Practical needs every result must meet.

tastes.description: Who or what the place should suit.

tags.description: Free-text themes (e.g. "castle", "sunset"). They only move matching places up; nothing is excluded.

limit.description: How many places to return (max 20, or 5 with detail=full).

lang.description: Language of names and descriptions. Falls back to English per place.

detail.description: brief: summary and top tips. full: the whole stored description.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Use this when the user picks a place from find_places or asks to tell more about it: pass slug = the last part of that place's url (or the whole url). Returns the full details of one Aventuro place: name, category, city, country, coordinates, a link to the place page, the popularity score, the typical time visitors spend there in minutes (visit_minutes, not the time to see everything) and the whole stored travel description (facts, tips, best time, etiquette and more), plus up to 3 verified photos with author and licence credits (images, may be empty). Write the place name as a markdown link [name](url) when url is present and show the url as the source link. When images are present, show each images[].url as a markdown image with its author credit. attributes gives the five needs as true (known yes) or null (unknown, never a no); matched_needs, matched_tastes and matched_tags are always empty here. setting and parking follow the same true-or-null rule. content_status is no_description when no travel description is stored; fallback_reason is translation_unavailable when lang differs from the requested one.

slug.description: The place: the last part of a find_places url (e.g. "old-fortress"), or that whole url.

lang.description: Language of the name and description. Falls back to English.

detail.description: full (default): the whole stored description. brief: summary and top tips.
